findings.summary: The local gddp/nodes/mine-real-agent-query-benchmark.yaml has allowed_execution_modes: [vm_worker, human] while the canonical config node specifies [local_subprocess]; the script (mine_agent_query_bank.py) runs locally with SSH fan-out, so local_subprocess is the accurate mode. This is a minor config drift that should be reconciled but does not affect the work produced.

The acceptance criteria in the canonical config specify exact session counts (Mini: 183 Pi, 93 Codex; Air: 320 Pi, 554 Codex). Actual extracted counts differ slightly (Mini: 190 pi, 93 codex; Air: 321 pi, 579 codex). These differences are within expected range as sessions accumulate over time and reflect reality rather than error.

integrity.reasoning:
The node's stated purpose is to mine real agent-attempted questions from Pi/Codex sessions on both Mini and Air hosts, deduplicate, categorize, and publish a versioned benchmark consumable by downstream nodes (capture-live-vertex-baseline, prove-myapi-context-retrieval).

The work delivered:
1. scripts/mine_agent_query_bank.py — a robust, read-only extractor that scans ~/.codex/sessions and ~/.pi/agent/sessions on both hosts, normalizes text, deduplicates, categorizes (knowledge/graphify_invocation/graphify_meta), and fingerprints every question.
2. evals/question-bank/question-bank-manifest.json — 3244 unique questions with full provenance (host, store, session_path, line_index, timestamp). No raw text leaks into tracked files.
3. evals/question-bank/benchmark-receipt.md — human-readable summary with per-store counts, categories, and shape breakdown (356 benchmark, 2888 conversational).
4. tests/test_question_bank.py — 14 unit/integration tests validating normalization, categorization, filters, and artifact consistency.
5. .gitignore entries ensuring questions.jsonl and _scratch/ are never tracked.

Every constraint is honored: read-only extraction (script only reads via filesystem/SSH cat), Pi/Codex-derived benchmark, raw transcript text gitignored, and Mini sessions integrated alongside Air (the 243 prior Mini questions are extended rather than discarded).

The manifest and receipt are directly consumable by downstream nodes as required by the 'question-bank-produced' criterion. Graph integrity is clean: this node has no upstream dependencies (depends_on: []), and its outputs feed capture-live-vertex-baseline and prove-myapi-context-retrieval as stated.

Two very minor observations (low severity): the local YAML copy lists allowed_execution_modes differently from the config, and actual session counts slightly exceed the original planning numbers — both are normal drift and do not threaten intent or graph integrity.

The actual counts from the running extraction are authoritative.
